speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I need to understand what is causing your acute diarrhea. How long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and have there been any episodes of vomiting or fever?

speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Antibiotic-associated diarrhea, likely Clostridioides difficile infection.

I have already noted your recent treatment with levofloxacin for pneumonia and the onset of watery diarrhea with abdominal cramping. To confirm this, do you have any history of similar episodes, or has anyone in your household been diagnosed with diarrhea recently? Additionally, please tell me if you are experiencing blood in your stool or signs of dehydration like dizziness.
